details:
Hello VRChat Team,

I would love to see an official library of prebuilt world templates available within VRChat Creator Companion or through the VRChat Creator Hub.

Many new creators want to build worlds but don't know where to start. Having professionally designed templates would make world creation much more accessible while encouraging more people to create content for the platform.

Some template ideas could include:

Hangout worlds

Apartments and homes

Cafés

Clubs and event venues

Parks and outdoor spaces

Fantasy environments

City streets

Horror maps

Game worlds

Avatar Worlds

Empty optimized base maps for customization

Each template could include optimized lighting, baked navigation, interaction examples, Udon setup, spawn points, mirrors, pickups, seating, portals, and performance-friendly settings that creators can easily modify to fit their own vision.

Benefits:

Makes world creation easier for beginners.

Saves creators time by providing a solid foundation.

Encourages more high-quality worlds to be published.

Promotes best practices for optimization and performance.

Helps maintain consistency with VRChat's recommended world setup.

I believe an official template library would lower the barrier to entry for new creators while still allowing experienced creators to build unique and creative experiences from a reliable starting point.

Thank you for considering this suggestion and for continuing to improve VRChat for creators and players alike.
title: Add Official Prebuilt World Templates
